The '''2015–16 Saint Joseph's Hawks basketball team''' represented [[Saint Joseph's University]] during the [[2015–16 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The Hawks, led by 21st year head coach [[Phil Martelli]], played their home games at [[Hagan Arena]] and are members of the [[Atlantic 10 Conference]]. The Hawks finished the season 28–8, 13–5 in A-10 play to finish in fourth place. They defeated [[2015–16 George Washington Colonials men's basketball team|George Washington]], [[2015–16 Dayton Flyers men's basketball team|Dayton]], and [[2015–16 VCU Rams men's basketball team|VCU]] to be champions of the [[2016 Atlantic 10 men's basketball tournament|A-10 tournament]] and earn the conference's automatic bid to the [[2006 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]]. As a #8 seed, they defeated [[2015–16 Cincinnati Bearcats men's basketball team|Cincinnati]] in the first round, their first NCAA Tournament victory since [[2003-04 Saint Joseph's Hawks men's basketball team|2004]], to advance to the second round where they lost to [[2015–16 Oregon Ducks men's basketball team|Oregon]]. [[DeAndre’ Bembry|DeAndre' Bembry]] was named A-10 player of the year.

==Previous season==
The [[2014–15 Saint Joseph's Hawks men's basketball team|Hawks]] finished the [[2014–15 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2014–15 season]] 13–18, 7–11 in A-10 play to finish in tenth place. They lost in the second round of the [[2015 Atlantic 10 men's basketball tournament|A-10 tournament]] to [[2014–15 St. Bonaventure Bonnies men's basketball team|St. Bonaventure]].
